items.statement: Where an OTC drug is approved in a new drug application, the manufacturer reports quality defects to FDA.
items.quote: Manufacturers of OTC drugs approved in a new drug application are required to report quality defects
items.condition: OTC drug approved in a new drug application

items.statement: Where an OTC drug is marketed without an approved application (monograph drug), the manufacturer, packer or distributor named on the label submits to FDA any report it receives of a serious adverse event associated with the drug when used in the United States.
items.quote: the manufacturer, packer, or distributor whose name appears on the label of an OTC drug without an approved application (i.e., OTC monograph drugs) must submit to FDA any report received of a serious adverse event associated with such drug when used in the United States
items.condition: named on the label of an OTC monograph drug; serious adverse event in the United States

items.statement: Establish and follow written procedures for periodically reviewing complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations of product discrepancies.
items.quote: manufacturers must establish and follow written procedures for periodically reviewing complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations of product discrepancies

items.statement: When investigating, review an appropriate number of batches, both approved and rejected, and, where applicable, the records for those batches, so that all product that may be affected is fully investigated and suitable follow-up action is taken.
items.quote: Firms must also review an appropriate number of batches, whether approved or rejected, and, where applicable, records associated with the batches, to ensure that all potentially affected product is thoroughly investigated and appropriate follow-up action is taken
items.condition: where applicable, records associated with the batches
